definitions.gloss: top-tier; world-class; superb; of the highest caliber
definitions.explanation: Exceeding even first-rate quality. Used to describe people, skills, products, or organizations that are among the very best in their field.

examples.japanese: {超一流|ちょういちりゅう}のシェフが{作|つく}った{料理|りょうり}だ。
examples.english: This is a dish prepared by a world-class chef.

examples.japanese: {超一流|ちょういちりゅう}の{選手|せんしゅ}になるには{才能|さいのう}だけでは{足|た}りない。
examples.english: Talent alone is not enough to become a world-class athlete.

examples.japanese: この{大学|だいがく}は{超一流|ちょういちりゅう}の{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}を{輩出|はいしゅつ}してきた{名門|めいもん}だ。
examples.english: This university is a prestigious institution that has produced world-class researchers.

notes:
Composed of {超|ちょう} (super, beyond) and {一流|いちりゅう} (first-rate). The prefix {超|ちょう} intensifies {一流|いちりゅう}, indicating a level above even first-rate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {超一流|ちょういちりゅう}の{選手|せんしゅ} (world-class athlete)
- {超一流|ちょういちりゅう}の{企業|きぎょう} (top-tier company)
- {超一流|ちょういちりゅう}のホテル (world-class hotel)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {超一流|ちょういちりゅう}: beyond first-rate, world-class
- {一流|いちりゅう}: first-rate, top-class
- {最高峰|さいこうほう}: the very pinnacle, the highest peak
